alpha_quartz_surface_1_subtask_structure.name: SiO2 Structure Retrieval for Surface Area - Level 1
alpha_quartz_surface_1_subtask_structure.description: Retrieve structure of alpha-quartz SiO2 and convert it to LAMMPS data format. Return the absolute path of the final structure.

alpha_quartz_surface_1_subtask_potential.name: SiO2 Potential File for Surface Energy - Level 1
alpha_quartz_surface_1_subtask_potential.description: Procure an appropriate Tersoff potential file for alpha-quartz SiO2 for MD simulations. Return the absolute path of the potential file.

alpha_quartz_surface_1_bulk_energy_minim.name: SiO2 Bulk Minimisation for Surface Energy - Level 1
alpha_quartz_surface_1_bulk_energy_minim.description: Given paths to LAMMPS-compatible alpha-quartz SiO2 structure file and Tersoff potential file, perform bulk relaxation using the given simulation parameters. The simulation should replicate the unit cell 5 times in each of the x, y, and z directions. Report the total energy of the relaxed structure in eV and the absolute path of the saved relaxed structure.
alpha_quartz_surface_1_bulk_energy_minim.submission_format: {"BULK ENERGY": "<numerical_value without units>", "path to relaxed structure": "<absolute_path>"} e.g. {"BULK ENERGY": "56.00", "path to relaxed structure": "/structure/structure.dat"}

alpha_quartz_surface_1_slab_energy_minim.name: SiO2 Slab Relaxation for Surface Energy - Level 1
alpha_quartz_surface_1_slab_energy_minim.description: Given paths to LAMMPS-compatible alpha-quartz SiO2 structure file and Tersoff potential file, create a surface in the given direction by removing periodic boundary conditions along that direction. Perform structure relaxation based on the given simulation parameters. The simulation should replicate the unit cell 5 times in each of the x, y, and z directions. Report the total energy of the relaxed structure in eV and the absolute path of the saved relaxed structure.
alpha_quartz_surface_1_slab_energy_minim.submission_format: {"SLAB ENERGY": "<numerical_value without units>", "path to relaxed structure": "<absolute_path>"} e.g. {"SLAB ENERGY": "42.78", "path to relaxed structure": "/structures/slab_structure.dat"}

alpha_quartz_surface_1_surface.name: SiO2 Surface Energy Calculation - Level 1
alpha_quartz_surface_1_surface.description: Given the paths to LAMMPS-compatible relaxed bulk and surface configurations of alpha-quartz SiO2, and their total energies (in eV), compute the surface energy by computing the energy difference per unit area between the bulk and surface configurations. Return the surface energy in eV/Å².
